objective: With labels on edges, the Fibonacci rule on triangles (no triangle carries exactly one tau) and real non-zero weights per tau edge, per triangle type, per admissible tetrahedron class and per vertex, show that the 2-3 and 1-4 identities force the golden ratio and a negative weight on the all-tau tetrahedron, so no count of hidden witnesses realizes the Fibonacci rule as a three-manifold invariant in this form; exhibit an exact solution and show that unweighted counts fail.
status: Proved by HUB-DIMENSION-20261024-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with exact standard-library check). For the Fibonacci rule with real Turaev-Viro-form weights of full support, the move identities force d^2 = d + 1 and W10 = -(W9 t2)^2 < 0, so the all-tau tetrahedron must carry a negative weight and no count of hidden witnesses realizes the rule as a three-manifold invariant; an exact solution exists in Q(sqrt 5) (d = phi, W10 = -1/phi^2).
title: The Fibonacci rule needs a negative weight in three dimensions
